evals.name: promotional-blurb
evals.prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads like it was written by a person, not an AI. Preserve every fact. Output only the rewritten text, nothing else.

Nestled in the Gonder region of Ethiopia, Alamata Raya Kobo stands as more than just a town — it is a living testament to the region's rich cultural heritage. Its vibrant traditions — from the rhythms of daily life to the enduring legacies of its communities — reflect a broader story of resilience and continuity. What was once a quiet crossroads has, in many ways, become a focal point of cultural identity in northern Ethiopia.
evals.expected_output: A plain, factual rewrite that drops the promotional padding. It should name the place, its region, and country, and say something simple and concrete about it. Should read like a neutral encyclopedia line.
evals.source: Nestled in the Gonder region of Ethiopia, Alamata Raya Kobo stands as more than just a town — it is a living testament to the region's rich cultural heritage. Its vibrant traditions — from the rhythms of daily life to the enduring legacies of its communities — reflect a broader story of resilience and continuity. What was once a quiet crossroads has, in many ways, become a focal point of cultural identity in northern Ethiopia.
